image_description: A close-up shot of a beaded necklace featuring amber-colored spherical beads, white heart-shaped beads, and silver wire-wrapped components. The necklace is laid out on a textured purple fabric background with faint script patterns. A large circular pendant with a blue/green inlay is visible on the right side.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text/script pattern on the purple fabric appears slightly warped and inconsistent in perspective, typical of AI-generated backgrounds where text-like textures are simulated but not legible.

Some of the silver wire wraps connecting the beads appear to merge into the beads without a clear physical anchor point, or the wire thickness varies inconsistently, suggesting slight structural logic errors common in AI generation.
The elliptical shape of the pendant does not perfectly align with the perspective of the rest of the necklace lay-out, appearing slightly flattened or oddly angled relative to the adjacent beads.

To verify that the beads are distinct objects and the wire connections are topologically continuous without melting or floating parts.
To assess the overall realism, lighting consistency, and texture quality of the metal and beads.

Reflectivity and material consistency of silver components

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the wire-wrapping details. In AI images, wires often fail to physically encircle the beads properly, instead appearing to fuse with them. Also, scrutinize the background text; if it is nonsensical gibberish, it is a strong indicator of AI generation despite the high quality of the foreground subject.
